latest.title: Securing the Cloud: A Beginner's Guide to AWS Security Best Practices
latest.description: Cloud security is more than just deploying resources—it's about protecting identities, data, applications, and infrastructure. This beginner-friendly guide explores essential AWS security best practices, including IAM, MFA, encryption, Amazon S3 security, network protection, CloudTrail, GuardDuty, and Security Hub. Learn how these services and security principles help build a safer and more resilient cloud environment.

latest.title: Dockerizing a Streaming Engine on AWS
latest.description: A hands-on guide to deploying Wowza Streaming Engine on AWS EC2 using Docker Compose. Learn how to build a cloud-based live streaming infrastructure, ingest RTMP streams from OBS Studio, deliver HLS streams to viewers using VLC, and restream live content to YouTube and other social media platforms.

latest.title: AWS VPC Explained: How AWS Networking Works Behind the Scenes
latest.description: Explore how Amazon VPC works and understand the fundamentals of AWS cloud networking. Learn about public and private subnets, Internet Gateways, route tables, Security Groups, and Network ACLs through simple explanations and real-world examples. A beginner-friendly guide to understanding how AWS resources communicate securely and how cloud network architecture is designed. 🚀

latest.title: What If You Could Run AWS Without AWS?
latest.description: What if you could build and test applications using AWS services without connecting to the actual AWS cloud? Meet AWS Emulator, a new tool from AWS that brings local AWS development to your machine. Let's see how it works, what makes it interesting, and why developers should pay attention.

latest.title: Building Secure and Scalable Serverless Applications with AWS
latest.description: Explore how AWS serverless services work together to build scalable applications without managing servers. Learn practical architecture patterns, security considerations, monitoring strategies, and cost optimization techniques.

latest.title: Your VPN Knows Who Connected. Does It Know What They Connected From?
latest.description: User authentication is only one part of zero-trust access. Explore how AWS Client VPN device posture assessment uses device trust providers, Cedar policies, and continuous evaluation to make network access depend on device health.

latest.title: My IBC 2026 Takeaways: AWS Cloud, MCP and the Agentic Future of Media
latest.description: Exploring key takeaways from IBC 2026, where cloud technologies, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and agentic AI are shaping the future of broadcast and media workflows. A look at how intelligent automation, interoperability, and AI-driven operations are transforming the media industry.

latest.title: Building and Deploying Microservices on AWS Using Docker, Amazon ECR, ECS, and Fargate
latest.description: A step-by-step technical guide to building and deploying containerized applications on AWS using Docker, Amazon ECR, Amazon ECS, and AWS Fargate. Learn how to create container images, store them in ECR, deploy applications using serverless containers, and test your deployment to establish a scalable microservices architecture.

latest.title: Don't forget to maintain the streak
Securing Web Applications on AWS: A Practical Guide to Cloud Security Best Practices
latest.description: Learn how to secure a web application hosted on AWS using services such as IAM, AWS WAF, Amazon VPC, Secrets Manager, KMS, and CloudWatch. Explore practical security practices for managing access, protecting sensitive data, securing network traffic, and monitoring application activity through a layered AWS security architecture.

trending.title: AWS Emulator: First Impressions From a Real Serverless App
trending.description:
In this post, you will learn about my experience moving my open-source serverless service to this new open-source emulator, my impressions, the gaps I hit, and my recommendation on whether you should try it for your own services.

I also turned what I learned into an open-source skill that answers that question for your own repository. More on it at the end.

trending.title: What Werner Wore: The Watches of re:Invent
trending.description: For fourteen years Werner Vogels closed re:Invent with his keynote, and while everyone was listening to him, I spent an evening looking at his wrist. From a bronze IWC Big Pilot and a Breitling Transocean to Panerai, Timex, Armani, Garmin and Samsung, this is a year-by-year look at the watches he wore on stage from 2012 to 2025, what is inside them, and what this mix of Swiss mechanics, simple quartz and smartwatches tells about the engineer who chose them.

trending.title: Blocking an AI agent's shortcuts with tools: what verifying code comments taught me about steering and MCP
trending.description: An AI agent asked to verify code comments kept taking shortcuts: trusting comments, staging predictions, and deriving test answers from the implementation. This post sorts out which shortcuts were fixed with steering in a Kiro Power and which needed MCP tools or container isolation.

trending.title: Can AI agents escape a Lambda MicroVM sandbox? Strands Box prevented it.
trending.description: AI agents are starting to act outside the lines they are given, so I tested the worst case: I put one in a Lambda MicroVM and told it to escape, with 13 techniques from current security research. The microVM boundary held the flag, the credentials and the control plane on its own, but the agent still tunnelled data out over DNS. A Strands-Box-style policy stopped that too, blocking 44 of 49 moves and cutting sensitive exposure from 9 kinds to 0.

trending.title: Give an OpenAI GPT-Live voice agent a phone number with Sinch Functions
trending.description: Answer phone calls with an OpenAI GPT-Live voice agent using the Sinch Functions realtime template, deployed from the Sinch CLI with one rented number.

trending.title: How emulators might catch what you might miss
trending.description: Coding agents write your code and your tests. Running those tests against emulators catches behavior the agent never thought to mock.

trending.description: A hands-on AWS networking challenge demonstrating how to design and implement a secure cloud network using Amazon VPC, public and private subnets, Internet Gateways, route tables, NAT Gateways, and security groups. This step-by-step guide covers network configuration, connectivity testing, and AWS networking best practices.
